```sql
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ps.points), 0)
   FROM main.results r
   JOIN main.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
   JOIN main.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
   JOIN main.points_scheme ps ON r.positionOrder = ps.position AND ps.scheme_id = 'PS2010'
   WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
     AND ra.year = 2010
     AND ra.date <= '2011-03-01')

   JOIN main.points_scheme ps ON r.positionOrder = ps.position AND ps.scheme_id = 'PS2010'
   WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
     AND ra.year = 2009
     AND ra.date <= '2011-03-01')
```
